headline: Top-ranked USC hosts Michigan State seeking statement win
subhead: The Spartans arrive in Los Angeles desperate to shake off an opening loss against a perfect Trojans team.

xFactor.why: Michigan State's quarterback will need to limit mistakes against USC's aggressive defensive scheme after managing only 18 points against Washington.

keyMatchup: USC's pass rush versus Michigan State's offensive line will determine whether the Spartans can establish rhythm or fall into another low-scoring hole.
body: Michigan State arrived in week one ranked tenth but left Washington with a loss that exposed cracks in execution. The Spartans managed just 18 points, a concerning start for a program with playoff ambitions. Now they travel to face an undefeated USC squad that rolled past Colorado with both efficiency and poise, setting themselves up as an early season power.

USC's defense proved opportunistic in week one, forcing mistakes and controlling tempo. If Michigan State's offense cannot establish balance and execute in the red zone, the Trojans will be content to control clock and capitalize on short fields. The Spartans have little margin for error; another sluggish performance could send them spiraling early in the season.
